"use client";

import { Field, HStack, Input } from "@chakra-ui/react"

export const InputWithField = () => {
  return (
    <HStack gap="10" width="full">
      <Field.Root required>
        <Field.Label>
          Email <Field.RequiredIndicator />
        </Field.Label>
        <Input placeholder="me@example.com" variant="subtle" />
      </Field.Root>
      <Field.Root required>
        <Field.Label>
          Email <Field.RequiredIndicator />
        </Field.Label>
        <Input placeholder="me@example.com" variant="outline" />
      </Field.Root>
    </HStack>
  )
}

"use client";

import { Field, Input, Stack } from "@chakra-ui/react"

export const InputWithFocusErrorColor = () => {
  return (
    <Stack gap="4">
      <Field.Root>
        <Field.Label>focusColor=lime</Field.Label>
        <Input placeholder="Focus me" css={{ "--focus-color": "lime" }} />
      </Field.Root>
      <Field.Root invalid>
        <Field.Label>errorColor=green</Field.Label>
        <Input placeholder="Email" css={{ "--error-color": "green" }} />
      </Field.Root>
      <Field.Root invalid>
        <Field.Label>errorColor=blue</Field.Label>
        <Input placeholder="Password" css={{ "--error-color": "blue" }} />
      </Field.Root>

      <Field.Root invalid>
        <Field.Label>variant=outline,focusColor=error</Field.Label>
        <Input placeholder="Focus me" variant="outline" />
      </Field.Root>
      <Field.Root invalid>
        <Field.Label>variant=subtle,focusColor=error</Field.Label>
        <Input placeholder="Focus me" variant="subtle" />
      </Field.Root>
      <Field.Root invalid>
        <Field.Label>variant=flushed,focusColor=error</Field.Label>
        <Input placeholder="Focus me" variant="flushed" />
      </Field.Root>
    </Stack>
  )
}

# Chakra UI Input

31 published Chakra UI input examples with complete pinned source and MIT attribution.

## Installation

- Complete MIT examples with a ChakraProvider using defaultSystem.
- Reuse the application-level ChakraProvider when integrating; keep HiddenInput in checkbox and switch compositions for keyboard and form semantics.

- Copy every returned file and preserve the MIT licence notice.
- Render the returned preview.tsx example, or integrate the example into your existing provider.
